fixed.en: Static CSV downloads retain the correct report filename and keep the download URL alive until the browser starts saving.
fixed.zh-CN: 静态 CSV 下载保留对应报表文件名，并延后释放下载链接以便浏览器完成保存。

fixed.en: The static web entry no longer uses a reserved Next.js directory.
fixed.zh-CN: 静态网页入口移出 Next.js 保留目录。

added.en: Head-office reward and store creation, editing and deletion with bilingual names, local reward images, store stock and staff store assignments.
added.zh-CN: 总部礼品与门店新增、编辑和删除，支持双语名称、本地礼品图片、分店库存及员工门店授权。

added.en: Soft deletion preserves historical references and blocks reward or store removal while redemptions await handover.
added.zh-CN: 软删除保留历史引用，礼品或门店仍有待交付兑换时阻挡删除。

added.en: GitHub Pages static-demo build and preview targets reuse the existing bilingual member, staff and head-office interfaces alongside the retained Next.js backend.
added.zh-CN: 新增 GitHub Pages 静态演示构建与预览目标，复用现有双语会员、员工和总部界面，同时保留 Next.js 完整后端。

added.en: The static demo persists synthetic data within one browser, shares it across the three workspaces and simulates phone verification without sending SMS.
added.zh-CN: 静态演示在同一浏览器中保存并向三端共享合成数据，模拟手机号验证，不发送短信。

changed.en: Head-office navigation and content scroll independently within the application viewport.
changed.zh-CN: 总部导航与内容在应用视口内分别滚动。

changed.en: Catalog forms preserve drafts during polling, lock pending submissions and show object-specific save and deletion results.
changed.zh-CN: 目录表单在轮询期间保留草稿，锁定待完成提交并显示对应对象的保存与删除结果。

fixed.en: Deleted or unavailable rewards leave current catalogs, empty catalogs show a clear state, and invalidated stores stop unsubmitted staff transactions without changing historical receipts.
fixed.zh-CN: 已删除或下架礼品退出当前目录，补全空目录状态；门店失效时阻止未提交员工交易，历史回执保持不变。

added.en: Separate member, staff and head-office entry points with server-enforced application surfaces and a three-port demo launcher.
added.zh-CN: 会员、员工与总部独立入口，服务端限制对应使用端，并提供三端口演示启动器。

added.en: Demo phone verification for returning members and new-member registration, with expiring codes, resend limits and one-time registration credentials.
added.zh-CN: 现有会员手机号验证登录及新会员注册演示，包含验证码过期、重发限制与一次性注册凭证。

added.en: Dedicated staff and head-office sign-in pages using authorized synthetic accounts.
added.zh-CN: 员工与总部使用各自授权合成账号的独立登录页面。

changed.en: Staff purchases and redemptions now follow member identification, entry, confirmation and receipt steps, with separate handover and record views.
changed.zh-CN: 员工消费与兑换按识别会员、填写、确认和回执顺序办理，另设交付与记录视图。

changed.en: English and Simplified Chinese interfaces use locally bundled Noto Sans and Noto Sans SC fonts.
changed.zh-CN: 英文与简体中文界面统一使用本地打包的 Noto Sans 和 Noto Sans SC 字体。

fixed.en: Phone normalization, verification recovery, phone-specific resend countdowns and form focus handling during member authentication.
fixed.zh-CN: 修正手机号规范化、验证失效恢复、按手机号区分的重发倒计时和会员认证表单焦点处理。

fixed.en: Transaction receipts retain exact server snapshots on idempotent retries; business errors preserve their HTTP status across server bundles.
fixed.zh-CN: 幂等重试返回准确的服务端交易回执快照；修正不同服务端构建模块之间的业务错误状态。

removed.en: The shared role-selection portal and Inter font dependency.
removed.zh-CN: 移除共用角色选择入口和 Inter 字体依赖。

added.en: Bilingual member, store and head-office workspaces with persistent synthetic data.
added.zh-CN: 中英双语会员、门店和总部界面及持久化合成数据。

added.en: Digital membership cards, member codes, purchase receipts, points and tier feedback.
added.zh-CN: 数字会员卡、会员码、消费回执、积分与等级反馈。

added.en: Purchases, refunds, reward redemption, collection and cancellation with transactional permissions and idempotency.
added.zh-CN: 消费、退款、礼品兑换、交付及取消，包含事务、权限与幂等校验。

added.en: Member, reward, stock, staff and rule management, filtered records and bilingual CSV exports.
added.zh-CN: 会员、礼品、库存、员工及规则管理，记录筛选和双语 CSV 导出。

added.en: Database migrations, domain regression tests and automated build checks.
added.zh-CN: 数据库迁移、业务回归测试及自动构建检查。

added.en: Local member experience specification for cards, receipts, points, tiers and redemption feedback.
added.zh-CN: 本地会员卡、消费回执、积分、等级及兑换反馈体验规范。

changed.en: Role-specific interface strategy and acceptance criteria for cross-device updates and motion.
changed.zh-CN: 三端界面策略及跨设备更新、动效验收标准。

added.en: Repository configuration and release metadata validation.
added.zh-CN: 仓库配置与版本记录校验。

added.en: Local product, architecture, interface, quality and delivery plans.
added.zh-CN: 本地产品、架构、界面、质量与交付规划。

removed.zh-CN: 已替换的 DADE 需求确认清单。
